title: builder.ServedGroupVersions is the shared source of 'what this process actually serves'
answers: Where is the logic that decides which group versions a running Grafana process serves?
How do route builders avoid mounting routes for kinds a manifest describes but this deployment doesn't serve?
body: pkg/services/apiserver/builder/common.go:ServedGroupVersions combines APIGroupBuilder.GetGroupVersions and AppInstaller.GroupVersions into one map[schema.GroupVersion]bool. It used to live in searchroutes as a private helper but was promoted because it's generic (reads only APIGroupBuilder/AppInstaller), and both searchroutes and keysroutes now call it to filter compiled-in app manifests down to group versions actually mounted in this process, avoiding routes for kinds a manifest declares but this deployment doesn't serve.
applies: Any route-building code that needs to intersect declared manifest kinds with what the running apiserver actually serves.
